title: Cloud model catalogue
description: Cloud provider models only, nested under their provider: what `pnpm run config N8N_ASSISTANT` offers for the n8n Assistant (the models served locally live in models.json); the first model of the first provider is the default of N8N_INSTANCE_AI_MODEL in ../n8n/docker-compose.yml. The CLI validates the same shape in packages/cli/src/schemas/assistant.ts, see ../../SPEC.md

id.description: The provider as n8n names it, the part of N8N_INSTANCE_AI_MODEL before the first slash, e.g. anthropic

label.description: The provider name shown by `config N8N_ASSISTANT`, e.g. Anthropic

models.description: The models recommended for the n8n Assistant, the first one offered first

id.description: The model as its provider names it, the part of N8N_INSTANCE_AI_MODEL after the provider, e.g. claude-opus-5-5 or deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro

label.description: The model name shown by `config N8N_ASSISTANT`, e.g. Claude Opus 5.5

note.description: A short hint shown after the model, e.g. what it needs
